name: harmohub-tests
description: Outils de test d'HarmoHub (le site lui-même n'a ni build ni dépendance). Voir tests/harmohub/PLAN.md.

scripts.test:e2e:module: sh -c 'firebase emulators:exec --project demo-harmohub --only auth,firestore "playwright test tests/e2e/$0"'
scripts.test:e2e:pr: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-harmohub --only auth,firestore "playwright test --project=chromium && playwright test --grep '@smoke|@critique' --project=firefox --project=webkit --project=edge --project=mobile-android --project=mobile-iphone --project=tablette"
